notes:
What’s new in 0.1.36:
• Beebo Inbox: drop new videos (or whole folders) into one folder and Beebo files them into your Movies and TV Shows folders for you.
• It never guesses: anything it isn’t sure about waits in “_Needs a look” for you to choose, and duplicates and junk are set aside — nothing is ever deleted.
• Undo last sort or put any file back for 30 days. Find it in Settings → Beebo Inbox.
• The old “New files drop folder” is now your Inbox, so there’s just one setting.
• Install Android 1.22 for the new layout: Home, Browse, Library, Play and More.
